notes: Ethereum mainnet. The constructor mints the full 1e27 units to its deployer. The launch factory distributes the swarm's 10% through its Merkle distributor, seeds the 90% pool allocation through Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, and forwards any remainder to economics.remainderTo. Transfers are fee-free and unrestricted by roles. initialPrice is provenance-only sqrtPriceX96 for paired-currency minor units per SDOG minor unit with SDOG as currency0; the deployer derives the actual opening price from the economics and deployed currency order. No token owner, admin, further minting, or burning.
